summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Vodafone Group Plc, a foreign private issuer, reporting a standard post-AGM board and committee appointment. The filing announces that Olaf Koch, following his election at the 2026 Annual General Meeting, has been appointed as a Non-Executive Director effective July 27, 2026, and will join the Remuneration and ESG Committees on August 1, 2026. No financial terms, consideration, premium, or strategic transaction is involved. This is a governance update under UK Listing Rules, not a special situation. As a purely administrative director change with no forced departure or contest, it does not qualify as Management Changes or any other category.
